metadata.name: AI Agent Mascot States
metadata.description: Animated 3D AI agent mascot for React and Three.js, inspired by Dots and Muse. A matte frog with idle, thinking, working, done and at-limit states, plus a liquid-glass status badge for chat UIs.
metadata.author: carolinaraulino
